youtube_description:
nergal from the controversial extreme metal band behemoth took some time to try and answer the question of what art is or could be… he is a very smart fella and hates definitions or labels, so that makes for an interesting interview.

you can find the entire audio interview, including photos at: http://www.shanebugbee.com/?p=2304

the noise-ish - buzz under that you’ll hear thru out the video is from the tour bus’ generator running constantly during our interview.

before I forget, remember, this is free to you, NOT FREE TO ME… please consider throwing something into our patreon fund, it’s what will keep this stuff flowing: http://www.patreon.com/creativeclass
